title: デビュー戦の後に・ザ☆センター！

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff…
Clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you so much! Be on the lookout for more Falco!
Smart Falcon finishes first in her debut race and manages to secure center stage for the winning concert.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Thanks…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: …It just doesn't feel real. I can hardly believe it.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm super happy I got to sing in front of everyone. It felt great to have the spotlight on me.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: But… that's not all.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: The lights the audience was waving… They were all for me.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Their cheers, their gazes… they were all honed in on center stage—on me.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: It was… amazing. Winning concerts are amazing.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: And being center stage is so much fun!
choice_data_list: It'll be even more exciting on a bigger stage.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: You're right! My debut concert was already so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I wanna perform on an even bigger stage! I wanna be a top Umadol!
Her first time center stage seems to have strengthened her resolve to reach the top.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah!
Smart Falcon is off to a great start and seems full of enthusiasm while we discuss our path moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I've got a question for you! What's the first thing a freshly-debuted Umadol has to do?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Nope! Well, actually, you're not entirely wrong!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: But Umadols are all about practical experience! I've gotta get more fans by putting on real concerts! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I wanna run tons of races and take center stage a bunch of times!
choice_data_list: In that case, let's go get first place!

text_block_list.text: Now that she's won her debut race, there's a much greater variety of races that Smart Falcon can compete in.
If she places first in those races, she'll naturally attract more attention.
choice_data_list: If we can win at least two races, I think people will really start noticing you!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Okay! ☆ I just gotta win, then!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Let's make everybody remember the up-and-coming Umadol, Falco! ♪
We set our sights on winning at least two races at the Pre-Open level or higher during junior year to jump-start Smart Falcon's fame.
